newsitem.title: UK: LCE white sugar ends down, October at the lows.
newsitem.headline: LCE white sugar ends down, October at the lows.

text.p: White sugar futures reversed from the recent highs on Thursday and dropped through support to end with the spot October contract down $2.80 at $348 per tonne.
December eased $1.40 and last traded at $346. Total volume on the exchange was a substantial 2,858 lots.
Traders said the market fell early on position squaring ahead of the expiry next week of the October contract. Renewed selling at the close took October down $1 to end at the low.
